verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a full webhook subscription system: HTTP POST event delivery, HMAC signature verification, troubleshooting tools, and specific event types (e.g., account-settings webhooks), directly enabling event-driven subscription patterns suitable for agentic/automated consumption. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of programmatically configuring webhook subscriptions via API (vs Customer Area UI) and independent third-party corroboration of reliability.
